problem.name: 5-inch FPV drone arm

load_cases.name: Full thrust
load_cases.reason: ~1.6 kgf max static thrust for a 2306 motor on 6S with a 5-inch prop (to cite from a motor thrust table) x 2 for dynamic loads

load_cases.name: Hard landing
load_cases.reason: arm hits the ground first (impact factor to cite)

notes: Side view along the arm: thrust is in-plane. The motor mount is a solid keep-in disc (no hole).
Deflection limit 0.5 mm: arm stiffness affects motor vibration seen by the flight controller.
Design space enlarged from 120 x 15 mm to 120 x 18 mm and pads recentred at y = 9 mm (2026-10-21), so the 8 mm motor ring fits inside the design area (spec 14.2).
references: Spec section 14.2 (approved 2026-10-20); thrust table and impact factor citations still to add

notes: metal: the element cap limits the min wall to 0.41 mm (process allows 0.40 mm)
every material passes at 15%: extending down to 12%
no fill level passes with the level above it also passing
